QuestInfo.name: [Guild Castle] To Open the Door
QuestInfo.0: Calm down Jack first, then ask what else you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1: Jack told you about the dragon, #rGrader#k, who personifies #bgreed#k. He and Benedict have lost the ability to fight the creature. If you can help Jack evacuate, and make your way to the abandoned office, you might find a way to stop the dragon.
QuestInfo.2:
The office is on the second floor of the castle lobby, but it's locked, with no way inside.

You feel the flow of that strange energy through the crack in the door.
